Pack: load 27.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[135,7]]]*/const D={"L_p135":"[[708,{\"name\":\"After Note: Tenya Iida (Sports Festival) #1\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf135\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_sports_festival\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_hosu_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":false}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Tenya Iida keeps coming to class after the Sports Festival and his brother's injury: he is present on Hero Name Day, where he writes only his given name, Tenya, and he is quiet, rigid and polite with everyone, brushing off concern. He tells no one that he means to find the Hero Killer Stain in Hosu during his internship with Manual.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf135\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[709,{\"name\":\"After Note: Tenya Iida (Sports Festival) #2\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf136\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_hosu_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Tenya Iida went after the Hero Killer Stain in Hosu during his internship, alone and without permission, and nearly died for it before Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki came to his aid. Stain was captured; the official account credits Endeavor, and the police made clear that the three students' part stays off the record. Tenya's left hand took nerve damage that may never fully heal, and he has chosen to keep the numb hand as a reminder. He has apologized to his brother and his classmates, holds the class to the rules more carefully than ever, and no longer hides his anger from his friends.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf136\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[710,{\"name\":\"After Note: Native\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf137\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_hosu_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Native was attacked by the Hero Killer Stain in a Hosu back alley and held helpless while Stain moved to kill him, until three U.A. Academy first-years, Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki, held Stain off. He has recovered and is back on patrol, with new scars under his costume. At police request he keeps to the official account that credits Endeavor with the capture, but he speaks of the students with open gratitude whenever the subject comes up, and checks the back alleys on his beat more often than the main street.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf137\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[711,{\"name\":\"After Note: Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf138\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Izuku Midoriya interned at Sir Nighteye's agency and fought in the Shie Hassaikai raid: he met Eri first, could not take her from Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) on the street, and in the raid fought Overhaul with Eri's help to carry her out, at great cost to his body. Sir Nighteye, by canon default, died of his wounds after the raid, and Izuku carries that loss and Mirio Togata's lost Quirk with him. He visits Eri at U.A. Academy often, with small treats and endless patience, and trains harder than before, determined to arrive in time the next time.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf138\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[712,{\"name\":\"After Note: Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf213\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_war_march\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Kirishima protects Mina and gets an anesthetic dose into Gigantomachia's mouth. Delivery creates a delayed chance to stop the giant rather than an instant victory. If the attempt was prevented, remember the failed attempt and do not grant him a success the story never earned.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf213\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[713,{\"name\":\"After Note: Tamaki Amajiki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf140\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Tamaki Amajiki held off three of the Shie Hassaikai's elite fighters alone in the underground during the raid so his team could push on, and beat them, ending the night in the hospital. He has recovered. Fat Gum and the pros now speak of him with open respect, and he still cannot take the praise. The raid also cost Mirio Togata his Quirk, and Tamaki carries that harder than his own wounds: he stays near Mirio, sits with him without talking, and has started, haltingly, to put himself forward in class, because he believes Mirio would want him to.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf140\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[714,{\"name\":\"After Note: Fat Gum\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf141\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Fat Gum's Trigger trail ended at the Shie Hassaikai: the raid broke the house that was supplying the drug, and the police are tracing what is left of it. In the underground he and Eijiro Kirishima beat Rappa and Tengai, and Tamaki Amajiki took on three of the house's fighters alone; Fat Gum and both students came out hurt and alive. Fat Gum has eaten his cushion back and is loud and cheerful again, proud of both students and quick to say so in public. He goes quieter when Mirio Togata's lost Quirk or Sir Nighteye comes up, and keeps a closer watch on Osaka's streets for anyone selling what remains of the supply.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf141\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 27"];})();
